M01.question: Which five sites have the highest single chlorophyll-a measurement recorded?
M01.sql: SELECT s.site_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id ORDER BY m.chlorophyll_a_ugl DESC LIMIT 5

M02.question: Which monitored sites have recorded a measurement whose dominant algae species is a cyanobacterium (phylum Cyanobacteria)?
M02.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.site_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id WHERE a.phylum = 'Cyanobacteria' ORDER BY s.site_name

M03.question: Which treatment methods have been applied at Blue Lake Reservoir?
M03.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.method FROM treatment_records t JOIN sites s ON t.site_id = s.site_id WHERE s.site_name = 'Blue Lake Reservoir' ORDER BY t.method

M04.question: Which sites have at least one measurement whose dominant species is highly toxic (toxicity level high)?
M04.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.site_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id WHERE a.toxicity_level = 'high' ORDER BY s.site_name

M05.question: How many water-quality measurements were taken at Blue Lake Reservoir?
M05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id WHERE s.site_name = 'Blue Lake Reservoir'

M06.question: Which algae species appear as the dominant species in measurements taken at coastal bay/lagoon sites?
M06.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.scientific_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id WHERE s.water_body_type = 'coastal_bay_lagoon' ORDER BY a.scientific_name

M07.question: For sites located in New Zealand, which treatment methods have been applied?
M07.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.method FROM treatment_records t JOIN sites s ON t.site_id = s.site_id WHERE s.country = 'New Zealand' ORDER BY t.method

M08.question: What is the average chlorophyll-a (ug/L) for measurements whose dominant species is Microcystis aeruginosa, to two decimals?
M08.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.chlorophyll_a_ugl), 2) AS avg_chl FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id WHERE a.scientific_name = 'Microcystis aeruginosa'

M09.question: Which algae species is most frequently the dominant species across all measurements?
M09.sql: SELECT a.scientific_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id GROUP BY a.scientific_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, a.scientific_name LIMIT 1

M10.question: Which sites have had at least one successful treatment and also recorded a chlorophyll-a reading above 200 ug/L?
M10.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.site_name FROM sites s WHERE s.site_id IN (SELECT site_id FROM treatment_records WHERE outcome = 'successful') AND s.site_id IN (SELECT site_id FROM water_quality_measurements WHERE chlorophyll_a_ugl > 200) ORDER BY s.site_name

S01.question: How many monitored water sites are currently active?
S01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sites WHERE active = true

S02.question: In how many distinct countries are the monitored sites located?
S02.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS n FROM sites

S03.question: What distinct types of water body are monitored?
S03.sql: SELECT DISTINCT water_body_type FROM sites ORDER BY water_body_type

S04.question: How many algae species have a high toxicity level?
S04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM algae_species WHERE toxicity_level = 'high'

S05.question: Which algae phylum has the most species recorded?
S05.sql: SELECT phylum FROM algae_species GROUP BY phylum ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, phylum LIMIT 1

S06.question: What is the average chlorophyll-a concentration (ug/L) across all water-quality measurements, to two decimals?
S06.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(chlorophyll_a_ugl), 2) AS avg_chl FROM water_quality_measurements

S07.question: What is the highest turbidity reading recorded, in NTU?
S07.sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(turbidity_ntu), 2) AS max_turb FROM water_quality_measurements

S08.question: How many distinct treatment methods have been used across all sites?
S08.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT method) AS n FROM treatment_records
